lines.en: I walk on four legs, swaying slowly.

lines.zh: 我的头顶有个斧状的冠。
lines.en: There's an axe-shaped crest on my head.
I graze on leaves as I walk.

lines.zh: 这么大一块，走起来也费劲。
lines.en: All this bulk makes walking work.
I follow the river. More grass that way.
I know the Montana plains.

lines.zh: 我踩着地面，泥就陷下去。
lines.en: I tread and the mud sinks.

lines.zh: 鸭嘴一样的嘴，很适合捋叶子。
lines.en: A duck-like bill is good for stripping leaves.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，谁也不用等我。
lines.en: I'm not quick. No one has to wait.

lines.zh: 前腿短，后腿长，我半坐着走。
lines.en: Short front legs, long hind. I walk half-seated.

lines.zh: 我沿着林子边走，避开深水。
lines.en: I keep to the treeline, away from deep water.
My tail swings to chase off flies.

lines.zh: 这一带的嫩芽，都被我啃过。
lines.en: I've grazed these shoots already.

lines.zh: 我走一步，停下来吃一口。
lines.en: One step, then a mouthful.
Wind pours a low note through my crest.
My crest is hollow. It can sound.

lines.zh: 我把头低下去，啃了一丛。
lines.en: I lower my head and take a clump.
The sound of water calms me.

lines.zh: 我抬头看远处，没有敌人。
lines.en: I look into the distance. No enemies.

lines.zh: 林子里的叶子，比草好吃。
lines.en: Leaves in the woods taste better than grass.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过来，看另一边。
lines.en: I turn slowly to see the other side.
I shift my weight onto my hind legs.

lines.zh: 这一片静，说明没什么事。
lines.en: This quiet means nothing's wrong.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤上有厚褶，很结实。
lines.en: Thick folds in my hide. Sturdy.

lines.zh: 我打了个响鼻，草叶都动。
lines.en: I snort and the grass stirs.

lines.zh: 我站着，头还在一动一动。
lines.en: I stand, head still moving.

lines.zh: 鸟落在我背上，我不赶它。
lines.en: A bird landed on my back; I let it stay.
I want somewhere with shallow water.
You stand straight, like a tree.
I raise my head, crest toward you.
I don't fight unless pushed.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻，你身上没有草味。
lines.en: I sniff. No grass on you.

lines.zh: 我的冠对着你，空空的响。
lines.en: My crest points at you and rings hollow.
I step closer, then stop.
You stepped back. Good.

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，也走得这么稳。
lines.en: So small, and walking so steady.
I lower my head to your level.
Following? Then follow.
This crest is only for sound.

lines.zh: 你站久了，我倒是习惯了。
lines.en: You've stood a while. I'm used to you.
I call out and give half a step.

lines.zh: 这一下打在腿边，我歪了。
lines.en: That hit my leg and I lurched.
Under the thick hide there is still a soft spot.
I turn my crest to my back to shield myself.
That threw my stride off.
I retreat under a tree and look.

lines.zh: 我把重心放低，别倒下去。
lines.en: I drop my weight so I don't go down.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢打，可我会还手。
lines.en: I don't like fighting. I'll answer it.
I pant and steady myself.
That I'll remember.
Leaves. I see them.
This crest can sound a note.
Good clump. Young shoots.
This crest of mine sounds a low note.

lines.zh: 你把蕨叶放低，我的冠先到。
lines.en: Lower the fern frond; my crest gets there first.
That smell. I'm having it.
One sweep and they're all gone.

lines.zh: 我的头冠是空心的，会响。
lines.en: My crest is hollow and sounds when I call.

lines.zh: 别拿走，这丛蕨叶我还没吃够。
lines.en: Do not take it; I have not had enough ferns.
Plants only. Nothing else.
You hit me and stagger back.
I'm heavy. Can't be moved.

lines.zh: 我后腿让开，尾巴扫起泥。
lines.en: My hind legs give way, and my tail flicks up mud.

lines.zh: 这一下，把脚下的泥压平了。
lines.en: That pressed the mud flat.
My feet are too heavy to feel you.

lines.zh: 我的后腿更有力，别站那。
lines.en: My hind legs are stronger. Don't stand there.
My duckbill crest sounds hollow.
That bent the grass.
I shift a block. Enough room.

lines.zh: 你身上有鸭嘴龙的味道了。
lines.en: You smell of hadrosaur now.

lines.zh: 我把冠抬起来，吹了一声。
lines.en: I raise my crest and sound it.
The sound crosses the whole wood.
An answer comes back. Lower.

lines.zh: 我们并排走，脚步合上了。
lines.en: We walk abreast, steps matching.
Two low notes meet between the trees.

lines.zh: 我头顶那顶斧状的冠，先靠过来。
lines.en: The axe-shaped crest on my head comes first.

lines.zh: 这一带的嫩芽，够我们吃。
lines.en: Enough shoots here for both.
We stand. Neither leaves.

lines.zh: 我们一起啃光同一丛蕨。
lines.en: Together we strip the same fern patch bare.
That sound will stay in the wood.

lines.zh: 我低头咬了一口，是叶子。
lines.en: I lower my head and bite. A leaf.
This one is hard; I spit it out.
I strip it with my bill and chew.
So small I can hardly reach.

lines.zh: 我把它叼在嘴边，走两步。
lines.en: I carry it at my bill for two steps.

lines.zh: 我把它拨开，继续找叶子。
lines.en: I push it aside and keep looking for leaves.
This will keep me chewing a while.

lines.zh: 我把它丢到脚边，回头再吃。
lines.en: I drop it by my feet for later.
Everything on the ground gets a sniff.
Wrong smell. I don't want it.

lines.zh: 我听见脚步，冠抬了起来。
lines.en: Footsteps reach me and my crest lifts.
I lower myself, ready to butt.
I don't start it. I'll answer it.
I've eaten half of this patch.

lines.zh: 我把冠对着你，声音会很大。
lines.en: Crest toward you. The sound will be loud.

lines.zh: 我后腿蹬实，只等你一步。
lines.en: My hind legs brace, waiting for one step from you.

lines.zh: 我后腿一蹬，能撞得很实。
lines.en: One kick of my hind legs lands solid.
This close — what do you want?

lines.zh: 我的鸭嘴张开，露出扁齿。
lines.en: My duckbill opens, showing flat teeth.
A bone axe sits on my head.
I know this wood.
I charge, and my crest hits you first.

lines.zh: 我头上的冠，能吹出低音。
lines.en: The crest on my head sounds low notes.

lines.zh: 这一片林子，我的同类常来。
lines.en: My kind come to these woods often.
My crest can make a sound.

lines.zh: 我的头冠吹出的声音，像低音管。
lines.en: My crest sounds like a low pipe.
I turn slowly to find an angle.
My crest keeps sounding low.
I'm not hurried. Nor quick.

lines.zh: 你在树后面，我看得见影子。
lines.en: You're behind a tree. I see the shadow.
I know this ground well.
I plant my hind legs.
Back further and you're at the river.
I lower my crest and wait for your first step.

lines.zh: 我后腿刨地，泥点飞起来。
lines.en: My hind legs paw the dirt, spraying mud.

lines.zh: 我的冠一响，林子都听见。
lines.en: One call from my crest and the whole forest hears.
I lower my head, crest forward.
You've no backup beside you.

lines.zh: 这一片草丛，够我藏半身。
lines.en: This grass hides half of me.

lines.zh: 我用后腿发力，把你顶开。
lines.en: I drive with my hind legs and butt you aside.

lines.zh: 后腿一蹬，整个身子压过去。
lines.en: I kick off and throw my weight.
My tail sweeps you aside.
I swing my head and my crest strikes your chest.
I stomp and mud flies.
Afterward I pull back. No more.
Cleared. I'll take the herd out.
Light. Enough to move you.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头，冠响了一下。
lines.en: I shake my head; the crest knocks.
You retreat, and I stop.

lines.zh: 鸭嘴龙喘起来，冠里都是声。
lines.en: When a lambeosaur pants, its crest fills with sound.

lines.zh: 这一下，是为了把路让开。
lines.en: That was to clear the path.

lines.zh: 我把你顶开，自己退回去。
lines.en: I shove you clear and pull back.

lines.zh: 这一下，我用了后腿的劲。
lines.en: That came from my hind legs.
I step out from behind the trees. Tall.
I raise my crest and listen to the wind.

lines.zh: 这一片林子，比记忆里密。
lines.en: Thicker woods than I remember.

lines.zh: 我低下头，先试了一口草。
lines.en: I lower my head and try a mouthful of grass.
Soft mud underfoot. Good going.
I tread soft mud into the ferns.

lines.zh: 我慢慢站直，四条腿都撑住。
lines.en: I straighten slowly on all four legs.

lines.zh: 远处有水声，我过去看看。
lines.en: Water sounds far off. Let me look.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住了一小片草。
lines.en: My shadow covers a patch of grass.

lines.zh: 这么大的身体，走起来很响。
lines.en: This much body makes noise moving.

lines.zh: 嫩叶的香气，从坡上飘来。
lines.en: The scent of young leaves drifts down the slope.

lines.zh: 我先看一眼四周，再低头吃。
lines.en: I check around before lowering my head.

lines.zh: 这里的叶子，比我想的多。
lines.en: More leaves here than I expected.
My crest sounds here for the first time.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走进草丛，草都分开了。
lines.en: I walk into the grass and it parts.
Enough here for me to stay a while.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴摆正，扫倒了几根草。
lines.en: I settle my tail and flatten some grass.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我身上的褶都动了。
lines.en: Wind stirs the folds in my hide.
The hide on my back curls and smokes.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，腿都软了。
lines.en: I fall from a height and my legs give.

lines.zh: 这么大的身子，河水一涨就沉。
lines.en: A body this big sinks when the river rises.

lines.zh: 炸浪把我推得坐了半截。
lines.en: The blast knocks me half down.

lines.zh: 箭卡在厚皮里，我甩不掉。
lines.en: An arrow is stuck in my thick hide and will not shake loose.

lines.zh: 力量缠住我，腿抬不起来。
lines.en: Force binds me and my legs won't lift.

lines.zh: 叶子都啃光了，我瘦了一圈。
lines.en: The leaves are gone and I've thinned.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，四条腿都僵了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and all four legs lock.
My four feet find nothing to stand on.
